_about: Site settings for the builds. base_path: the folder the site lives under: "" on signpostingsomerset.org.uk, "/signposting-somerset-v2" on the github.io preview of this repo (the build adds it to every link and image that starts with /). sheet_copy: where the nightly Places rebuild saves a copy of the published sheet on the site; the pages load it first (fast, and works when Google is slow), then check the sheet itself for anything newer. feedback_form_url: the Google Form behind the About tab's 'Suggest a change' button (leave empty to hide the button).
